Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
PRESS WORKING DIE SETS (PLAIN TYPE) 

PART II CENTRE POST SQUARE DIE SETS 

(Incorporating Amendment Nos 1 & 2) 



1. Scope — Covers dimensions and other requirements for {plain type) square die sets with two 
guide posts in central axis 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1 
3* Designation 

3.1 A centre post square die set of cast iron having a die space aj x qj = 8*^ ^ ^0 mm with gtnde post 
Type A with round ends and having length = 160 mm and with stepped solid (Type A) guide bushes of 
length I - 50 mm shall be designated as 

Die Set C 80 IS 10068 (Part II) 
along with guide pobts AR — 19/20 x 160 IS 7664 
and guide bushes A — 19/20 x 50 IS 8127 

3.2 A centre post square die set of mild steel having a die space a^ x a^ = 80 x 80 mm with guide posts 
Type B with tapered ends and having length = 160 mm and with guide bushes (Type B^ of length 
/ = 50 mm shall be designated as 

Die Set MS 80 IS 10068 (Part II) 
along with guide posts BT — 19/20 x 160 IS 7664 
and guide bushes B — 19/20 x 50 IS 8127 

3.3 A centre post square die set of cast steel having a die space a i x ai = 80 x 80 mm with guide posts 
type B with tapered end and shaving length = 160 mm and with guide bushes (Type B) of length 
/ ~ 50 mm shall be designated as 

Die Sets 80 IS 10068 (Part II) 
along with guide posts BT — 19/20 x 160 IS 7664 
and guide bushes B — 19/20 x 50 IS 8127 

4. Material — The top and bottom tool holders shall be made of mild steel of IS 226 1975 
'Specification for structural steel (standard quality) ( fifth revision )' or of cast iron of grade FG 260 of 
IS 210-1978 'Specification for grey iron casting ( third revision Y or cast steel of grade 23 45 of 
IS 1030-1974 'Specification for carbon steel castings for general engineering purposes ( becond 
revision )' 

5. General Requirements — The top and bottom tool holders shall be free from cracks, burrs and 
pits and shall satisfy for accuracy when tested as per test chart ( under preparation ) 

6. Marking 

6.1 The designation and the manufacturer's trade mark to appear at a prominent place on tool 
holders 

6.2 ISl Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution 



Adopted 28 January 1982
